name: Camping 101: Skinning

angles.text: Your path to making a Camp Chair leads to Ironforge, the dwarven mountain city and Alliance capital.
As a dwarf, you can find Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge and learn how skilled skinners make camp comforts from hides.
As a hunter, you can skin your prey in the wild and make a Camp Chair for resting between long tracks.

faq.answer: Skilled skinners go to Ironforge to learn how to make a Camp Chair from animal hides.
Balthus Stoneflayer teaches you to make a Camp Chair in Ironforge. First, show him you can skin beasts.
faq.q: Who teaches you to craft the camping item?

faq.answer: Go to Ironforge, the dwarven capital in the snowy peaks of Dun Morogh. Balthus Stoneflayer teaches skinners there who prove their skill.
faq.q: Where do you need to go to complete this quest?

faq.answer: You learn to make a Camp Chair from animal hides, giving you a place to rest in the field between dangers.
faq.q: What item do skinners learn to craft for their camp?

faq.answer: A Camp Chair gives you a place to rest on long wilderness treks and recover your focus before danger finds you.
faq.q: Why is crafting a camp chair useful for an adventurer?

faq.answer: Balthus Stoneflayer teaches you after you prove your skill at skinning beasts.
faq.q: What proficiency is required before Balthus will teach you?

sections.body: Skinning fallen beasts gives armorers and crafters leather to work with. Hides from cats, bears, and other beasts have uses in the field, too. You are sent to turn those materials into something useful at camp instead of selling them.
sections.title: Harvesting the Wilds

sections.body: Balthus Stoneflayer teaches skinners in Ironforge to make a Camp Chair from prepared pelts. First, you need to show him you know how to skin beasts. Only then will he share his crafting methods.
sections.title: The Artisan of Ironforge

sections.body: A Camp Chair gives you a place to sit by the fire and unwind while traveling. Rest there, and you can meet the next danger with your senses sharp and your strength restored.
sections.title: Rest and Readiness

summary: In Ironforge, skilled skinners learn to make a Camp Chair from animal hides. Balthus Stoneflayer teaches the craft after they prove their skill.
